items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: I played with Joe Oliver quite a while. In Ory's band.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you ever play with Joe Oliver or any of those? Oh, yeah.
I played with Joe Oliver quite a while. In Ory's band. So in Kid Ory's band.
Yeah, Kid Ory's band. Okay. I know, as Ory told me once, he used to use Henry Martin on drums too some. On drums, yeah. But not all the time.

items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: But over here, this is called Joe Oliver. Yeah.

ctx.x: And when he left Ory, he went out on the boat. Mm-hmm. That's why he learned to raise his music out on the boat. See? But that time, Wade had come back and started playing with Ory. Mm-hmm. Because Joe Oliver had left way a long time before, before Ory then. Yeah. After Ory went to California, well then they all hooked up together and made the band up over again after they got over there. Oh, yeah. Yeah, that's where Joe Oliver got the name of King Oliver after he got up there. But over here, this is called Joe…
Did you ever play many of the places in the district? Did you ever play at that old tuxedo dance hall? Yeah.
